build_nearest_neighbors_model: build a nearest neighbors model by fitting training data using the NeighborsBase._fit method
create_kneighbors_query: create a k-nearest neighbors query for multiple points using the KNeighborsMixin.kneighbors method
build_knn_graph: build a k-nearest neighbors connectivity or distance graph using the KNeighborsMixin.kneighbors_graph method
create_radius_neighbors_query: create a radius-based neighbors query for points within a given distance using the RadiusNeighborsMixin.radius_neighbors method
build_radius_neighbors_graph: build a radius-based neighbor graph using the RadiusNeighborsMixin.radius_neighbors_graph method
